bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; prohibiting state financial assistance to noncitizens; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 16A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[16A.1395] FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO NONCITIZENS PROHIBITED.

Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, a noncitizen, whether lawfully present or undocumented, is not eligible for state financial assistance. For purposes of this section, "state financial assistance" means any payment, grant, loan, in-kind assistance, subsidy, public assistance, or other form of financial aid or assistance funded by state tax revenue.
